subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Should the current-main compaction fix ship through the next normal release, or be isolated and backported to a v2026.7.x patch release?
rationale: The implementation problem is resolved on main, but only a release owner can choose cadence and accept the dependency and validation scope of a stable backport.

options.title: Ship in next release
options.body: Identify the fix SHA, confirm focused Ollama compaction coverage, and document the next standard release as the first fixed version.

options.title: Backport to v2026.7.x
options.body: Isolate the complete provider-stream change set and validate both main-session and fresh-process memsearch compaction before publishing a patch release.

recommendation.title: Ship in next release
recommendation.body: Identify the fix SHA, confirm focused Ollama compaction coverage, and document the next standard release as the first fixed version.

likelyOwner.reason: Their broad recent ownership of embedded-agent compaction makes them the best available routing candidate for release inclusion or backport scope.
